name: 🏋️ 健身房
desc: 签到·器械·更衣室·团课·预约·安全·会员卡·私教·营业时间·擦拭

items.en: Please sign in at the desk.
items.zh: 请在前台签到。

items.en: Wipe down each machine after use.
items.zh: 用完后请擦拭每台器械。

items.en: Bring a towel and a bottle.
items.zh: 请带一条毛巾和一个水瓶。

items.en: The locker rooms are down the hall.
items.zh: 更衣室在走廊尽头。

items.en: Free classes run every evening.
items.zh: 每天晚上都有免费团课。

items.en: Show your card to the staff.
items.zh: 请向工作人员出示会员卡。

items.en: The gym closes at ten.
items.zh: 健身房十点关门。

items.en: Please rack the weights neatly after every set.
items.zh: 每组练完请把杠铃片整齐归位。

items.en: You can book a private trainer at the front desk.
items.zh: 你可以在前台预约私人教练。

items.en: Group classes are posted on the board outside.
items.zh: 团课时间表贴在外面的公告板上。

items.en: Please return the dumbbells to their proper rack.
items.zh: 请把哑铃放回正确的架子上。

items.en: Your membership card lets you in at any hour.
items.zh: 你的会员卡可以随时刷卡进入。

items.en: Lockers are free, but bring your own lock.
items.zh: 储物柜免费，但请自带锁。

items.en: The pool reopens at six on weekday mornings.
items.zh: 泳池工作日早上六点重新开放。

items.en: If you are new here, a trainer can show you how the equipment works.
items.zh: 如果你是新来的，教练可以教你器械怎么用。

items.en: Members who reserve a court online will always get priority during our busy hours.
items.zh: 在线预约场地的会员在高峰时段始终享有优先权。
chunks: Members who reserve a court online

items.en: When a machine breaks down, please tell a staff member at the desk right away.
items.zh: 当器械出故障时，请立刻到前台告诉工作人员。
chunks: please tell a staff member at the desk
skeleton: 请到前台告诉工作人员

items.en: If you feel dizzy or short of breath, stop and sit down immediately.
items.zh: 如果你感到头晕或喘不上气，请立刻停下坐好。
chunks: If you feel dizzy or short of breath

items.en: Classes that fill up quickly usually require you to sign up a day early.
items.zh: 很快满员的团课通常需要你提前一天报名。
chunks: to sign up a day early

items.en: Because the treadmills are limited, please keep your workout under thirty minutes at peak times.
items.zh: 由于跑步机数量有限，高峰时段请把锻炼控制在三十分钟内。
chunks: please keep your workout under thirty minutes
skeleton: 请控制锻炼在三十分钟内

items.en: If your card expires this month, you can renew it at the desk today.
items.zh: 如果你的会员卡本月到期，今天就可以在前台续费。
chunks: If your card expires this month
